title: KU bags 4 medals in All India Inter-University Thang-Ta Championship in Manipur

ai.summary: The University of Kashmir's Thang-Ta team won four medals at the All India Inter-University Championship in Manipur, with the university's leadership congratulating their achievements.

facts.claim: The University of Kashmir’s (KU's) All India Inter University Thang-Ta team signed off with four medals at recently concluded All India Inter-University Thang-Ta Championship
facts.quote: The University of Kashmir’s ( KU's) All India Inter University Thang-Ta team signed off with four medals at recently concluded All India Inter-University Thang-Ta Championship, hosted by the National Sports University Manipur, under the aegis of Association of Indian Universities, New Delhi.

facts.claim: Haseeb Shafi won gold in Phunaba Ama (Weight Category, 58 kg)
facts.quote: Haseeb Shafi , Gold medal in Phunaba Ama (Weight Category, 58 kg)

facts.claim: Nida Andrabi won bronze in Phunaba Anishuba (Weight Category, 72 kg)
facts.quote: Nida Andrabi, bronze medal in Phunaba Anishuba, Weight Category, 72 kg)

facts.claim: Arjumand secured silver in Phunaba Anishuba (Weight Category, 60 kg)
facts.quote: Arjumand secured the silver medal in Phunaba Anishuba(Weight Category, 60 kg)

facts.claim: Hammad Bashir won bronze in Phunaba Anishuba (Weight Category, 62 kg)
facts.quote: Hammad Bashir claimed bronze medal in Phunaba Anishuba(weight category, 62 kg)

facts.claim: Vice-Chancellor Prof. Nilofer Khan congratulated the medalists
facts.quote: Vice-Chancellor KU Prof. Nilofer Khan, congratulated the medalists for their remarkable achievement and for bringing pride to the University.
